detail.longDescription: I am trying to figure out how often my lambda function is invoked, here is the basic query that I am using to get the gap between invocations: filter @type = "REPORT" | fields @timestamp | sort @timestamp asc | autoregress @timestamp as prev_ts p=1 | fields (toMillis(@timestamp) - toMillis(prev_ts)) as gap_ms | display @timestamp, prev_ts, gap_ms | limit 100 However, even though the results show values for @timestamp and prev_ts , gap_ms is always empty. I've checked with different LLMs and none have any suggestions that work. In fact, 'Amazon Q' suggests something that doesn't work either. Any ideas why I am getting an empty gap_ms ?
